title: Alan Jones trial live updates: former radio broadcaster in Sydney court for day two of indecent assault case – latest news
description:
Former 2UE and 2GB radio broadcaster is facing 22 charges. Jones, 85, has pleaded not guilty

  • Warning: This live blog may contain graphic content when discussing evidence in the trial

  • Jones allegedly gifted cash and car to teenager he kissed after commenting on sprinter’s penis, trial hears

  • Analysis: Jones argues ‘rivalry’ and ‘treachery’ but after decades wielding the sword of public opinion, he’s the one on trial

Complainant J tells court he would mention his girlfriend to try to avoid Jones’s assaults

Complainant J has told the court that a “tactic” he’d use to try to avoid Alan Jones’s alleged assaults was to bring up the girlfriend he had at the time.

I already mentioned to him that I’d never done anything like that with a man. I thought if I brought up my girlfriend it would help.

Did you do it?

No, I put my underpants on and then I put the robe on and went out.
